title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Reaches Six Provinces
subtitle: Health officials warn that the virus is spreading faster than any previous epidemic in history.

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has now reached a sixth province. Officials report that the virus is spreading at an alarming speed compared to past epidemics. Health workers are facing major challenges, including strikes and a lack of funding. Experts are currently testing new vaccines and treatments to fight the disease. The situation remains critical as authorities struggle to contain the virus.
summary.zh: 剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情已蔓延至第六個省份。官員指出，與過去的流行病相比，該病毒正以驚人的速度擴散。醫護人員面臨罷工與資金短缺等重大挑戰。專家目前正測試新的疫苗與治療方法以對抗該疾病。由於當局難以控制病毒，局勢依然危急。

paragraphs.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached a new and concerning stage. According to The Guardian World, the virus has now spread to a sixth province. This update follows reports from health officials that the current outbreak is moving much faster than the deadly 2014-16 epidemic in west Africa. At that time, it took much longer to reach the number of cases seen today.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國（Democratic Republic of the Congo, DRC）的伊波拉疫情已進入一個令人擔憂的新階段。根據《衛報》國際版報導，該病毒目前已擴散至第六個省份。在此之前，衛生官員曾指出，此次疫情的擴散速度遠快於二零一四至二零一六年西非那場致命的流行病。當時，疫情花費了更長的時間才達到今日的病例數。

paragraphs.en: Jean Kaseya, the director general of the Africa CDC, confirmed that a death occurred in Bas-Uele province, an area that was previously safe. The person had traveled from Isiro in Haut-Uele province to the capital of Bas-Uele, where they later died. This movement of people is a major reason why the virus is reaching new areas. The Guardian World reports that more than 2,100 people have already died, with over 4,500 total cases recorded. The outbreak was first identified in Ituri province, which still holds the highest number of cases.
paragraphs.zh: 非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa CDC）總幹事卡塞亞（Jean Kaseya）證實，先前被視為安全的下韋萊省（Bas-Uele）出現了一起死亡病例。該名患者從上韋萊省（Haut-Uele）的伊西羅（Isiro）前往下韋萊省首府，隨後在那裡過世。人員的流動是病毒擴散至新地區的主要原因。《衛報》國際版指出，目前已有超過兩千一百人死亡，累計病例數超過四千五百例。疫情最初是在伊圖里省（Ituri）發現的，該省至今仍是病例數最多的地區。

paragraphs.en: Health experts are deeply worried about the speed of the virus. The Guardian World noted that the current death toll was reached three times faster than in the 2014-16 epidemic. Officials have warned that the virus is moving ahead of their efforts to stop it. A major issue is that between 60% and 70% of new cases are found outside of the groups being watched by health teams. This makes it very difficult to track and stop the spread of the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生專家對病毒的擴散速度深感憂慮。《衛報》國際版提到，此次疫情達到當前死亡人數的速度，比二零一四至二零一六年那場流行病快了三倍。官員警告，病毒的傳播速度已超越了防疫工作的進度。一個主要問題是，百分之六十到七十的新病例是在衛生團隊監控名單之外發現的，這使得追蹤並阻斷疾病傳播變得極為困難。

paragraphs.en: Ebola is a serious and often fatal disease. It is highly contagious, meaning it spreads easily through contact with body fluids like blood or vomit. It can also be passed on through contact with contaminated items such as clothing or bedding. Because the virus is so dangerous, the work of health professionals is vital. However, these workers are facing many problems. The Guardian World reported that some health staff at a treatment center in Ituri went on strike because they had not been paid for three months. This led to the temporary closure of the center, which further hurts the response to the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 伊波拉是一種嚴重且通常致命的疾病。它具有高度傳染性，這意味著它能透過接觸血液或嘔吐物等體液輕易傳播。它也能透過接觸受污染的物品（如衣物或寢具）來傳播。由於病毒極度危險，醫護人員的工作至關重要。然而，這些工作人員正面臨許多問題。《衛報》國際版報導，伊圖里省一家治療中心的醫護人員因三個月未領到薪水而發動罷工，導致該中心暫時關閉，進一步削弱了對抗病毒的應變能力。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the strikes, those fighting the outbreak face many other obstacles. These include a lack of global aid, threats from rebel groups, and deep distrust from local communities. Some people have even shared false information, claiming that Ebola is not real. This misinformation makes it harder for doctors and nurses to provide care and keep people safe. Additionally, there are no approved vaccines or treatments for the specific Bundibugyo strain of the virus that is causing this outbreak. This strain is genetically different from those seen in the past, which means previous medical tools may not work as well.
paragraphs.zh: 除了罷工之外，對抗疫情的人員還面臨許多其他障礙，包括全球援助不足、叛軍威脅，以及當地社區的深層不信任。有些人甚至散布錯誤資訊，聲稱伊波拉並非真實存在。這些錯誤資訊使得醫師與護理師更難提供照護並確保民眾安全。此外，目前沒有針對導致此次疫情的特定本迪布焦（Bundibugyo）病毒株的核准疫苗或治療方法。該病毒株在基因上與過去發現的類型不同，這意味著先前的醫療工具可能效果不彰。

paragraphs.en: Despite these challenges, there is some hope for the future. Clinical trials for two possible treatments began last month in Ituri. Furthermore, two vaccines made specifically for this strain are now being tested on people for the first time. Some officials believe that if the response is organized and happens at the same time across all affected areas, the situation could improve within three months. However, experts also warn that the peak of the outbreak might still be months away, and the entire process could last up to a year.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨這些挑戰，未來仍有一線希望。兩種潛在治療方法的臨床試驗已於上個月在伊圖里省展開。此外，兩種專為此病毒株研發的疫苗也首次在人體上進行測試。一些官員認為，如果防疫工作能組織得當，並在所有受影響地區同步進行，情況可能在三個月內好轉。然而，專家也警告，疫情高峰可能還需數月才會到來，整個過程可能持續長達一年。

paragraphs.en: While the situation in the DRC is the main focus, neighboring countries are also on alert. Uganda has reported 20 cases in its capital, Kampala, though no new cases have been found there since June. The international community continues to watch the situation closely as the DRC works to manage the crisis. The true scale of the outbreak is still unknown, as recent data shows the virus may have started spreading as early as February, months before it was officially declared. As the virus continues to move into new regions, the need for funding, support, and cooperation remains more urgent than ever.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然剛果民主共和國的情況是關注焦點，但鄰國也處於警戒狀態。烏干達已在其首都坎帕拉（Kampala）通報了二十起病例，不過自六月以來當地未再發現新病例。隨著剛果民主共和國努力控制危機，國際社會持續密切關注局勢。疫情的真實規模仍是未知數，因為近期數據顯示，病毒可能早在二月就已開始傳播，比官方宣布的時間早了數月。隨著病毒持續進入新地區，對資金、支援與合作的需求比以往任何時候都更加迫切。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Happening faster than someone can respond to or control.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 進展速度超過（某人的）控制或應對能力。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡的 moving ahead of 並非指物理上的移動，而是指病毒擴散速度快於防疫措施。文中：Officials have warned that the virus is moving ahead of their efforts to stop it.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A period of time when workers stop working to protest about pay or conditions.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（打擊），這裡作名詞用。文中：The Guardian World reported that some health staff at a treatment center in Ituri went on strike because they had not been paid for three months.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Watching carefully for danger or problems.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語形容對潛在危險保持高度警覺。文中：While the situation in the DRC is the main focus, neighboring countries are also on alert.

quiz.question: What does the article identify as a primary cause for the virus spreading into new provinces?

options.A: The lack of effective vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain.
options.B: The movement of individuals traveling between different provinces.
options.C: The temporary closure of treatment centers due to staff strikes.
options.D: The failure of neighboring countries to report early cases.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第二段明確指出，Bas-Uele 省原本是安全的，但因為有人從 Haut-Uele 省的 Isiro 旅行到 Bas-Uele 後死亡，這種人員流動是病毒擴散到新區域的主要原因。選項 A 雖然是困難點，但並非導致擴散的原因；選項 C 是應對挑戰，非擴散原因；選項 D 與文章提到的鄰國監控情況不符。

quiz.question: Why is the current Ebola outbreak in the DRC considered more difficult to manage than previous ones?

options.A: Because the virus is now airborne and spreads much faster than before.
options.B: Because the majority of new cases are occurring in areas already under strict quarantine.
options.C: Because a significant portion of new infections are happening outside the surveillance of health teams.
options.D: Because the 2014-16 epidemic in west Africa had fewer cases and was less deadly.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到，60% 到 70% 的新病例發生在醫療團隊監控的群體之外，這使得追蹤與阻斷病毒變得極其困難。選項 A 錯誤，文章僅提到接觸傳染；選項 B 與原文矛盾，原文說是在監控範圍外；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到 2014-16 年疫情擴散速度較慢，並未說其致死率較低。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'obstacles' mean in the context of fighting the outbreak?

options.A: Physical barriers or walls built to contain the virus.
options.B: Difficulties or challenges that prevent progress.
options.C: Financial incentives offered to health workers.
options.D: Medical tools used to test for the virus.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在第五段中，作者列舉了缺乏國際援助、叛軍威脅及社區不信任等因素，這些都是阻礙防疫工作的困難。因此 'obstacles' 在此處意指「障礙」或「難題」。選項 A 將詞彙過度字面化；選項 C 與 D 的意思與該段落描述的負面挑戰情境完全相反。

quiz.question: What is the central message regarding the current Ebola situation in the DRC?

options.A: The outbreak has been successfully contained due to new vaccines and clinical trials.
options.B: The crisis is primarily caused by health workers going on strike in treatment centers.
options.C: The virus is spreading rapidly, and despite some hope, the situation remains complex and requires urgent, coordinated support.
options.D: The current strain of Ebola is identical to previous ones, making it easy for doctors to use existing medical tools.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體論述了疫情擴散的速度、面臨的各種挑戰（如誤導資訊、缺乏資金、病毒變異），以及雖然有臨床試驗帶來希望，但整體情勢依然嚴峻且需要國際合作。選項 A 過於樂觀，目前仍在測試階段；選項 B 僅為挑戰之一，非核心主旨；選項 D 與第五段描述的基因差異事實相反。
